breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.9 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.8].
breakdown.reason: The ground truth resolves the conflict between the time domain `t in [0, 0.8]` and the output time `T=0.9` by changing the output time to `T=0.8`. The Agent correctly identified the discrepancy but then decided to follow the incorrect output time of T=0.9, which is outside the specified domain. This is not how the ground truth handled the issue, and therefore the inconsistency was not resolved correctly.
